description: Éoliennes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR. La carte d'implantation des éoliennes indique la répartition des éoliennes autorisées par le Ministre de l'Environnement en vertu de la législation sur les établissements classés. En fonction de leurs disponibilités, les indications relatives à la puissance installée, la hauteur de moyeu et du diamètre décrit par l'hélice peuvent être consultées. Coverage: SIG-GR. The publisher named on the listing is SIG-GR. Its keywords include bruit, energie-energie-eolienne, energie-electrique, environnement, energie, grand-duche-du-luxembourg. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
